notes.title: 1.3.16 Patch Update
notes.content: Fixed an issue where some units became uncontrollable neutral units.

notes.title: 24-03-25 PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
*Fixed the glitch of Tech effects not applying to certain bonus units.
*Fixed the glitch where healing units could not be retrieved.
*Corrected the attack logic of some hostile units.

notes.title: 12.08 Patch Note
notes.content:
[Fixes and Updates]
*Fixed the glitch of Construction Bonus not taking effect.
*Fixed some description errors in certain levels. 
*Updated the SDK.

notes.title: V1.3.8 PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
Fixed the glitch that stacked Techs return back to initial effects.
Fixed the glitch that some Techs are missing or not taking effect.

notes.title: V1.3.6 PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
Fixed the glitch of losing items upon picking up.
Fixed the display glitch of some units.
Fixed the refreshing glitch upon purchasing in the shop.

notes.title: V1.3.5 PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
Added new Commands and adjusted Command Setup.
Added new airdrop reinforcements (spawned in random events).
Fixed the glitch of Healing Drone not recovering the shield.
Optimized the display of Xeno Tutorial.

notes.title: V1.3.3 PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
Added new events that can drop Tech.
Added Xeno Tutorial to help learn about game mechanics and more.
Tech rewards can now be refreshed with Metal.
Adjusted Healing/Swift/Shield devices: their buffs no longer stack up.
Fixed the glitch of item lost.
Fixed the glitch in Airdrop Mines.
Fixed the glitch in Smoke Grenades & Decoy Devices.
Fixed the glitch of game crash when launching grenades.
Fixed the missing texts.
Fixed the glitch of Beam Tower.

notes.title: V1.2.7 PATCH NOTE
notes.content: Regular content update, including optimizations and bug fixes.

notes.title: V1.2.5 PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
*Added troop & building recycling: you can now select troops/buildings to recycle them when disengaging from battles for 5s.
*All new troops will be airdropped to battlefront.
*Fearless Company's troop training is shortened.
*Adjusted the drop rate of tier 2 Techs
*Adjusted Bodyguard Floater & Wave Attacker's positions in battles.
*Fixed the wrong prompt of "Tunneling Worm" when defeating targets.
*Fixed the registration glitch on certain phones.
*Fixed the glitch of no level selection in Chapter 4.
